before.runs:
; Layer C: multi-page runs. Level 0 holds the entries; each sealed page's
; first key and parent-held reference become one entry of the level above.
; A build owns one writer row per level; its caller supplies pages and
; records each sealed page. Every call is bounded; :more resumes.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "run-geometry")
(include-book "runs-schema")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

; A format parameter, not a ceiling on stored entries: with 64 KiB pages and
; index entries of at most 350 bytes, six levels address over 10^13 pages.

; Field rows a build owns: one writer range per level, then one index-entry
; region where a sealed page's first key and reference are assembled.
(defconst *fn2-run-build-index* (* *fn2-run-max-levels* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-run-build-fields* (+ *fn2-run-build-index* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))

(defcolumns fn2-run-builds
 ((phase (:enum fn2-run-build-phase (:idle :adding :finishing :done :failed)))
  (schema :u60) (run :u60) (height :u8) (wbase :u32) (entries :u60) (pages :u60)
  (crow :u32) (hbase :u32) (hslot :u32) (hgen :u60) (fields :u32) (limit :u32)
  (history :u60) (incarnation :u60) (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)))

(defcolumns-predicate fn2-run-buildp (b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 :shape ((fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers))
 :tests ((natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds))
      (<= (+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-max-levels*)
          (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))))
(defmacro fn2-run-level-writer (b level)
 `(+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase ,b fn2-run-builds) ,level))
(defmacro fn2-run-level-phase (b level)
 `(fn2-run-writers-phase (fn2-run-level-writer ,b ,level) fn2-run-writers))

; Idle every level writer of a build, ordinal zero.
(defun fn2-run-reset-writers (n w fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-writers :measure (nfix n)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (natp n) (natp w))))
 (cond ((zp n) (mv :ok fn2-run-writers))
       ((not (and (natp w) (< (+ w (- n 1)) (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers)))) (mv :bounds fn2-run-writers))
       (t (let ((fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-put (+ w (- n 1)) (phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*) (ordinal 0))))
           (fn2-run-reset-writers (- n 1) w fn2-run-writers)))))
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-reset-writers (n w fn2-run-writers) :position 1 :raw-rows t)

; Start a build. The hash slot is a C-owned workspace whose first
; 32 * levels bytes are zeroed here; level L's sealed hash is copied to
; offset 32 L for its parent entry.
(defun fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation
                             okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 schema) (unsigned-byte-p 60 run) (unsigned-byte-p 32 wbase)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 crow) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hslot)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 hgen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 fields) (unsigned-byte-p 32 limit)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 history) (unsigned-byte-p 60 incarnation)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((unless (member (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds)
                       (list *fn2-run-build-phase-idle* *fn2-run-build-phase-done*)))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reset hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-run-zero (* 32 *fn2-run-max-levels*) hslot hgen 0 okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-reset-writers *fn2-run-max-levels* wbase fn2-run-writers))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-put b (phase *fn2-run-build-phase-adding*) (schema schema) (run run)
                        (height 0) (wbase wbase) (entries 0) (pages 0) (crow crow) (hbase hbase)
                        (hslot hslot) (hgen hgen) (fields fields) (limit limit)
                        (history history) (incarnation incarnation) (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen))))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
(fn2-run-builds-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 1 :disable nil
 :hyps ((fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds)))
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 2 :prefix "-WRITERS-PRESERVES" :disable nil)
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 3 :prefix "-POOL-PRESERVES")

; Give level LEVEL a fresh page: a C-owned 64 KiB workspace and its physical
; identity, from the caller's allocator reservation. The page's ordinal is
; the build's page count at that level, kept in the writer row across pages.
(defun fn2-run-build-page-kind (b level slot gen unit epoch counter page-kind fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 8 page-kind) (natp level) (< level *fn2-run-max-levels*)
                    (< level (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (w (fn2-run-level-writer b level))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase w fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (ordinal (fn2-run-writers-ordinal w fn2-run-writers))
      ((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
       (fn2-run-open w slot gen (fn2-run-builds-schema b fn2-run-builds) 1 level
                     (fn2-run-builds-run b fn2-run-builds) ordinal
                     page-kind
                     unit epoch counter (fn2-run-builds-history b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-incarnation b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-okind b fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-builds-oslot b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-ogen b fn2-run-builds)
                     (+ (fn2-run-builds-fields b fn2-run-builds) (* level *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
                     (fn2-run-builds-limit b fn2-run-builds) fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
  (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
; Default callers retain the ordinary run page kinds. A directory producer
; uses the same implementation with its declared :manifest page kind.
(defun fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (fn2-run-build-page-kind b level slot gen unit epoch counter
  (if (zp (nfix level)) *page-kind-run-data* *page-kind-run-index*) fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
(fn2-run-builds-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 1 :disable nil)
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 2 :prefix "-WRITERS-PRESERVES" :disable nil :raw-rows t
 :hyps ((fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 3 :prefix "-POOL-PRESERVES")

; All levels below L idle.
(defun fn2-run-below-idle (l wbase fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-writers :measure (nfix l)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (natp l) (natp wbase)
              (<= (+ wbase l) (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers)))))
 (or (zp l)
     (and (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase (- l 1)) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*)
          (fn2-run-below-idle (- l 1) wbase fn2-run-writers))))
; The highest level that needs action, top down: (mv action level).
(defun fn2-run-scan (l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) :measure (nfix (+ 1 l))
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (integerp l) (< l *fn2-run-max-levels*))))
 (if (or (not (integerp l)) (< l 0)) (mv :idle 0)
  (let* ((wbase (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds)) (w (+ wbase l))
         (phase (fn2-run-writers-phase w fn2-run-writers)))
   (cond ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-closing*) (mv :close-step l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-heading*) (mv :head l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealing*) (mv :seal-step l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-failed*) (mv :failed l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*)
          (if (and finishing (equal (+ 1 l) (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))
                   (equal (fn2-run-writers-ordinal w fn2-run-writers) 0)
                   (fn2-run-below-idle l wbase fn2-run-writers))
              (mv :root l) (mv :promote l)))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*)
          (if (and (< 0 l) (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase (- l 1)) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*))
              (mv :need-page l)
            (fn2-run-scan (- l 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
         ((and finishing (fn2-run-below-idle l wbase fn2-run-writers)) (mv :finish-close l))
         (t (fn2-run-scan (- l 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))))))

(defthm fn2-run-scan-level-natp
 (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-scan l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
 :rule-classes ((:type-prescription :typed-term (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-scan l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))))

; One bounded unit of pending page work. Returns (mv code level ...): :more
; after work, (:sealed L) once when a page has sealed (its writer row then
; names the page; the caller records it), and without work (:promote L),
; (:need-page L), (:root L) or :idle for the caller to act on.
(defun fn2-run-build-work (b budget fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool
                             fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-restarts-wfp fn2-run-restarts)
              (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc)
              (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests) (natp budget))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-scan fn2-run-close-step fn2-run-head fn2-run-seal-step fn2-run-seal-context fn2-run-close
                                            fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows)))))
 (b* ((finishing (equal (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-build-phase-finishing*))
      (height (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (<= height *fn2-run-max-levels*))
       (mv :bounds 0 fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
      ((mv action l) (fn2-run-scan (- height 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))
      (w (+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds) l))
      (crow (fn2-run-builds-crow b fn2-run-builds))
      (hrow (+ (fn2-run-builds-hbase b fn2-run-builds) l))
      ((unless (and (natp l) (< w (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))
                    (fn2-run-writerp w fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields)
                    (< crow (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)) (< crow (fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-fc-context))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 hrow)))
       (mv :bounds l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
  (case action
   (:close-step
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool)
          (fn2-run-close-step w budget fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
     (mv (if (member-eq code '(:ok :more)) :more code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:head
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-head w fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (< (fn2-digest-slot crow *fn2-fc-previous-seal*) 4294967296)))
          (mv (if (eq code :ok) :bounds code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
         (fn2-fc-context (fn2-run-seal-context w crow hrow fn2-run-writers fn2-fc-context)))
     (mv :more l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:seal-step
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fc fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
          (fn2-run-seal-step w crow hrow budget fn2-run-writers fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests))
         (pages (+ 1 (fn2-run-builds-pages b fn2-run-builds)))
         (fn2-run-builds (if (and (eq code :ok) (unsigned-byte-p 60 pages))
                             (fn2-run-builds-set-pages b pages fn2-run-builds) fn2-run-builds)))
     (mv (case code (:ok :sealed) (:more :more) (otherwise code))
         l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:finish-close
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-close w fn2-run-writers)))
     (mv (if (eq code :ok) :more code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:root
    (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-done* fn2-run-builds)))
     (mv :root l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (otherwise
    (mv action l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))))

; Finishing: the remaining open levels close bottom up; an empty run has no
; root and is :empty.
(defun fn2-run-build-finish (b fn2-run-builds)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-builds
  :guard (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds)))))
 (cond ((not (equal (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-build-phase-adding*)) (mv :state fn2-run-builds))
       ((zp (fn2-run-builds-entries b fn2-run-builds))
        (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-done* fn2-run-builds))) (mv :empty fn2-run-builds)))
       (t (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-finishing* fn2-run-builds))) (mv :ok fn2-run-builds)))))

; Promotion, the generic parts. Check: the sealed level L can promote now
; (:go), or the level above needs a page first, growing the height when L is
; the top. Child reference: the parent-held hash goes to the hash slot at
; 32 L and the reference fields are set by the ref layout's field names
; relative to CB, the index layout's CHILD- base. Commit: :full closes the
; parent (the promotion stays pending); :ok idles L for its next page.
(defun fn2-run-promote-check (b l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (natp l))))
 (b* ((wbase (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (and (natp l) (< (+ 1 l) *fn2-run-max-levels*) (< l (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))))
       (mv :levels fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase l) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds))
      ((when (equal (+ 1 l) (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds)))
       (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-height b (+ 2 l) fn2-run-builds))) (mv :need-page fn2-run-builds)))
      ((when (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase l 1) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*))
       (mv :need-page fn2-run-builds)))
  (mv :go fn2-run-builds)))
(fn2-fc-shape fn2-run-promote-check-shape (fn2-run-promote-check b l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (and (fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))
 ((fn2-run-builds 1)))
(in-theory (disable fn2-run-promote-check))

(defun fn2-run-child-ref (w l cb eb hrow hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
              (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp w) (natp l) (natp cb) (natp eb) (< l *fn2-run-max-levels*)
                    (< w (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))
                    (<= (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-num-fields*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (< eb (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 hslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 hgen) (fn2-digest-rowp hrow fn2-digests)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-digest-store 32 hrow hslot hgen (* 32 l) okind oslot ogen fn2-digests fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (unit (fn2-run-writers-unit w fn2-run-writers)) (epoch (fn2-run-writers-epoch w fn2-run-writers))
      (counter (fn2-run-writers-counter w fn2-run-writers)) (kind (fn2-run-writers-page-kind w fn2-run-writers))
      (entries (fn2-run-writers-entries w fn2-run-writers)))
  (if (not (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 unit) (unsigned-byte-p 60 epoch) (unsigned-byte-p 60 counter)
                (unsigned-byte-p 60 kind) (unsigned-byte-p 60 entries)))
      (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool)
   (let* ((h (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-expected-hash*))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-storage-domain*) 0 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-physical-unit*) unit fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-writer-epoch*) epoch fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-allocation*) counter fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-page-kind*) kind fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-encoded-length*) *fn2-run-page-size* fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value h 1 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-slot h hslot fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-gen h hgen fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-off h (* 32 l) fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-len h 32 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value eb entries fn2-fields)))
    (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-pool)))))
(fn2-fc-shape fn2-run-child-ref-shape
 (fn2-run-child-ref w l cb eb hrow hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
 (and (fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-digestsp fn2-digests)
      (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests))

before.machines-c:
; Layer C in the served core (C-ONE-ASSEMBLY; seam C-S1, docs/c-ordered-runs.md
; §4a and §8): the engine's resident tables registered as core children, and
; each transaction's field-row stripe. The identity decision over them is
; machines-c-groups.lisp's (two exact reads); a transaction's writes go
; through the private successor (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp). The run
; and range assemblies are range-served.lisp's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "range-served")
(include-book "machines-b")
(include-book "successor-schema-geometry")
(include-book "c-snapshot")
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-state")
(include-book "run-physical-geometry")
(include-book "run-physical-harvest")
(include-book "c-source-observer")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Field rows. B's format work uses a 128-row stripe per format slot from row 0
; (commit.lisp: base = 128 * row); transaction T's stripe is the
; *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*-row stripe ending (transactions - T) stripes before
; the table's end. machines-b sizes the table for both (fn2-b-field-rows). In
; a stripe (C-STRIPE): the successor's 24 write slots from +0, one 48-row
; block each (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp), then the exact lookup's area
; from +1152: its query at +4 (the identity decision's key: namespace, name,
; profile, algorithm, digest), the run reader at +84 (its rows also take the
; entry a bind writes).
(defconst *fn2-idc-stride* *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*)
(defconst *fn2-idc-b-stripe* 128)
(defconst *fn2-succ-slots* 24)
; Successor offsets/capacities are declared once from actual schemas.
(defconst *fn2-idc-ident* (* *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-succ-block*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-eb* (+ *fn2-idc-ident* 4))
(defconst *fn2-idc-rb* (+ *fn2-idc-eb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-required-fields* (fn2-successor-required-fields *fn2-succ-fields-max* *fn2-succ-values-max* *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-run-entry-rows* *fn2-run-reader-fields*))
(assert-event (<= *fn2-idc-required-fields* *fn2-idc-stride*))
(assert-event (and (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-reader-fields*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ (* (- *fn2-succ-slots* 1) *fn2-succ-block*) *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (equal (fn2-b-field-rows '((:t . 3) (:format-slots . 2))) (+ (* 2 *fn2-idc-b-stripe*) (* 3 *fn2-idc-stride*) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*))))

;; The overlay rows a profile gets when it names none (:identity-overlays):
;; a batch takes one private overlay per schema it writes, and a POST
;; writes up to 10 today (the five identity records, article, outcome,
;; counts, overview, addr) of the 16 a transaction could name; B keeps two
;; batches in flight (its two commit rows) and the sealer works on the
;; frozen ones behind them. So 16 schemas x 3 batches. Each overlay in use
;; holds one arena of :identity-arena-bytes from the pool; the pool must
;; carry them (c-ordered-runs.md §5, capacity).
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlays-default* 48)
;; The sealer's merge (C5, sealer.lisp) reads at most eight sources, one run
;; cursor each, after every read row's (t + 9R ..).
(defconst *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 8)
;; A reader merges at most *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* (8) sources of a schema:
;; its overlays (active, frozen or private) and its live runs. The sealer
;; keeps a schema to *fn2-idc-run-budget* runs (it merges every run once a
;; schema holds that many, sealer.lisp) and stage keeps it to
;; *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* overlays (a transaction that would take one more
;; waits, :full, until the sealer catches up: machines-c-stage.lisp).
(defconst *fn2-idc-run-budget* 4)
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* (- *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* *fn2-idc-run-budget*))

;; Each child's init is a function whose guard is proved here once, so the

(defmacro fn2-idc-child (field stobj init why)

  `(progn
    (defun ,fn (profile ,stobj)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs ,stobj :guard (fn2-idc-profilep profile)
                     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep)))))
     ,init)
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-TYPE")
     (implies (and (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") ,stobj) (fn2-idc-profilep profile))
              (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-WFP")
     (implies (fn2-idc-profilep profile) (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "-WFP") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (in-theory (disable ,fn))

; Decision D's stripe base, or :bounds when D is no decision row or the
; stripes would reach into B's (FCROWS format slots).
(defun fn2-idc-stripe (d fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (let* ((n (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides)) (rows (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
  (if (and (natp d) (< d n) (natp rows) (natp n)
           (<= (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix fcrows)) (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n))))
      (mv :ok (+ (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n)) (* *fn2-idc-stride* d)))
    (mv :bounds 0))))

before.sealer:
; Layer C1c, the sealer's engine half (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §5): a
; published (frozen) overlay becomes a sealed run through the real build,
; with a Ribbon filter for the identity summary, is installed in the resident
; view of runs (fn2-run-installed), and the overlay is retired with its arena
; released, in one step. The engine half names runs and pages itself (a run
; counter and a physical-unit counter in the seal row) and keeps every sealed
; page resident in the verified-page cache; B's run-replacement member (GC2)
; makes the run durable (the device half). The sealer machine
; (machines-c-sealer.lisp) drives fn2-seal-step from its arms. One seal row;
; its continuation is the row (phase, the overlay, the next entry, the run).
;
; Order (C-SEAL-ORDER): an overlay is sealable when it is frozen and no
; overlay of its schema that is frozen, private or active has a smaller SEQ;
; of the sealable ones the least SEQ goes first. Run identifiers grow, so run
; order follows SEQ order, and every overlay a reader still meets is newer
; than every run, which is what the readers' newest-wins rules assume.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-groups")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; The seal row. WBASE: the build's six writer rows, then the filter's; FBASE:
; its field rows (the build's, then the decoded entry, then the filter
; writer's); CROW: its checker row (B's format-row map: 3 + the upload
; windows), whose digest stripe holds the six levels' parent-held hashes
; (regions 129-134) and the filter's (135); FILL: the page fill. RUN and UNIT
; count the identifiers handed out.
(defconst *fn2-seal-eb* *fn2-run-build-fields*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-fw* (+ *fn2-run-build-fields* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-field-rows* (+ *fn2-seal-fw* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-writer-rows* (+ 1 *fn2-run-max-levels*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-hash-region* 129)
(defconst *fn2-seal-filter-region* (+ *fn2-seal-hash-region* *fn2-run-max-levels*))
(assert-event (and (< *fn2-fc-previous-seal* *fn2-seal-hash-region*) (< *fn2-seal-filter-region* *fn2-digest-stride*)))
(defconst *fn2-seal-hash-bytes* (* 32 *fn2-run-max-levels*))
; The schema whose runs carry a Ribbon filter: the identity summary (§4a),
; keyed by the name N, which the identity decision reads first; the filter
; holds each entry's name.
(defconst *fn2-seal-identity* *fn2-id-summary-sid*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-filter-field* *fn2-identity-summary-entry-field-name*)
(defcolumns fn2-seals
 ((phase (:enum fn2-seal-phase (:idle :build :filter :install :failed :release)))
  (sub (:enum fn2-seal-sub (:open :clear :add :drive :finish :solve)))
  (history :u60) (history-incarnation :u60)
  (o :u32) (pos :u32) (sid :u60) (run :u60) (runs :u60) (units :u60)
  (top :u8) (rslot :u32) (rgen :u60) (runit :u60) (rcounter :u60) (entries :u60)
  (hslot :u32) (hgen :u60) (filter :bool) (funit :u60) (fcounter :u60)
  (wbase :u32) (fbase :u32) (crow :u32) (fill :u32) (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)
  (k :u8) (rlo :u60) (ufirst :u60) (held :bool) (rg :u32) (sbase :u32) (cbase :u32) (qbase :u32) (rbase :u32)))

; Shapes (type, wfp, rows of every stobj returned), with every table's rows
; accessor folded (the shape lemmas of the callees are stated over them).
(defconst *fn2-seal-rows-folded*
 '(fn2-seals-rows fn2-run-cache-rows fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-restarts-rows
   fn2-ribbon-builds-rows fn2-ribbon-band-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows
   fn2-ranges-rows fn2-range-sources-rows fn2-run-cursors-rows fn2-run-paths-rows))
(defmacro fn2-seal-shape (fn args outs stobjs &optional (mode 't) reads)
 `(fn2-idc-fn-shape ,fn ,args ,outs ,stobjs ,mode ,(append reads *fn2-seal-rows-folded*)))

; Set the seal row's resources: idle, no run or unit handed out yet.
(defun fn2-seal-init (wbase fbase crow pagefill okind oslot ogen history history-incarnation fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seals :guard (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals)))
 (if (not (and (fn2-origin-physicalp history history-incarnation) (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 wbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 fbase)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 crow) (unsigned-byte-p 32 pagefill) (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
     (mv :bounds fn2-seals)
  (let ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-put 0 (phase *fn2-seal-phase-idle*) (sub *fn2-seal-sub-open*) (o 0) (pos 0) (sid 0) (run 0)
                                  (history history) (history-incarnation history-incarnation)
                                  (runs 0) (units 0) (filter 0) (wbase wbase) (fbase fbase) (crow crow) (fill pagefill)
                                  (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen))))
   (mv :ok fn2-seals))))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-init (wbase fbase crow pagefill okind oslot ogen history history-incarnation fn2-seals) (fn2-seals) (fn2-seals))
; The merge's read resources (C5): range row RG, its eight sources from
; SBASE reading through run cursors from CBASE, the query key's field rows
; at QBASE and the sources' reader rows from RBASE.
(defun fn2-seal-merge-rows (rg sbase cbase qbase rbase fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seals :guard (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals)))
 (if (not (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rg) (unsigned-byte-p 32 sbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 cbase)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 qbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rbase)))
     (mv :bounds fn2-seals)
  (let ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-put 0 (k 0) (rlo 0) (held 0) (rg rg) (sbase sbase) (cbase cbase) (qbase qbase) (rbase rbase))))
   (mv :ok fn2-seals))))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-merge-rows (rg sbase cbase qbase rbase fn2-seals) (fn2-seals) (fn2-seals))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The pick. Does an overlay of schema SID among rows O.. (K) in phase frozen,
; private or active have a SEQ below SEQ?
(defun fn2-seal-older-p (k o sid seq fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (or (and (member (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays)
                       (list *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-private* *fn2-overlay-phase-active*))
               (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
               (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix seq)))
          (fn2-seal-older-p (- k 1) (+ 1 o) sid seq fn2-overlays))))
(defun fn2-seal-sealable-p (o fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :guard (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)))
 (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*)
      (not (fn2-seal-older-p (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays)
                             (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays) fn2-overlays))))
; The sealable overlay with the least SEQ among rows O.. (K); BEST the row
; count when none.
(defun fn2-seal-pick (k o best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-seal-pick (- k 1) (+ 1 o)
                 (if (and (fn2-seal-sealable-p o fn2-overlays)
                          (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                              (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)))))
                     o best)
                 fn2-overlays)))
(defthm fn2-seal-pick-natp
 (implies (natp best) (natp (fn2-seal-pick k o best fn2-overlays))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
; Work is pending in the seal row when it is in a non-idle active phase
; (:build, :filter, :install, :release), or when it is :idle and a published overlay is
; sealable.
(defun fn2-seal-pending-p (fn2-seals fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-seals fn2-overlays) :guard (and (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays))))
 (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals))
      (let ((phase (fn2-seals-phase 0 fn2-seals)))
       (or (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-build*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-filter*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-install*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-release*)
           (and (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-idle*)
                (< (fn2-seal-pick (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) fn2-overlays)
                   (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-seal-older-p fn2-seal-sealable-p fn2-seal-pick fn2-seal-pending-p))

; Retire overlay O (frozen -> free) and release its arena.
(defun fn2-seal-retire (o fn2-overlays fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-ov-retire fn2-ov-advance fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-release-countp)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) (mv :bounds fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      (slot (fn2-overlays-slot o fn2-overlays)) (gen (fn2-overlays-gen o fn2-overlays))
      (okind (fn2-overlays-okind o fn2-overlays)) (oslot (fn2-overlays-oslot o fn2-overlays)) (ogen (fn2-overlays-ogen o fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (fn2-pool-release-countp slot fn2-pool)) (mv :bounds fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-overlays) (fn2-ov-advance o *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-free* fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release slot gen okind oslot ogen fn2-pool)))
  (mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool)))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-retire (o fn2-overlays fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-ov-advance fn2-pool-release-countp fn2-overlays-slot fn2-overlays-gen fn2-overlays-okind fn2-overlays-oslot fn2-overlays-ogen))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C5's merge, chosen when a seal starts (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §5). The
; frozen overlay O of schema SID is sealed together with SID's newest live
; runs (a suffix in run order, so the new run, whose identifier is greater
; than every run's, stands where they stood); its inputs retire when it
; installs and their pages are released unit by unit after it (:release).
; Size-tiered: a run joins while its entries are at most twice the entries
; gathered so far (O's, then each joined run's), so a schema holds about
; log2(entries) runs and an entry is rewritten about log2(n) times. Every
; run joins (FORCE) when the 64 KiB class or the installed view has at most
; one free row left (backpressure: the next seal needs a page and a row, and
; a merge frees its inputs'), or when the schema already holds
; *fn2-seal-run-budget* runs (a reader merges at most eight sources of a
; schema; stage keeps its overlays to the other four, machines-c.lisp). At
; most seven runs join, the overlay being the eighth source.
(defconst *fn2-seal-run-budget* *fn2-idc-run-budget*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-merge-runs* 7)
; Live runs of SID among rows R.. (K), and free rows.
(defun fn2-seal-live-runs (k r sid fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) 0
  (+ (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
              (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid)) 1 0)
     (fn2-seal-live-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) sid fn2-run-installed))))
(defun fn2-seal-free-rows (k r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) 0
  (+ (if (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-free*) 1 0)
     (fn2-seal-free-rows (- k 1) (+ 1 r) fn2-run-installed))))
(defthm fn2-seal-live-runs-natp (natp (fn2-seal-live-runs k r sid fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defthm fn2-seal-free-rows-natp (natp (fn2-seal-free-rows k r fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
; The runs that join, newest first from below BOUND (I more at most), ACC
; the entries gathered: (mv count least-run).
(defun fn2-seal-select (i acc bound force sid fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix i) :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (b* (((unless (posp i)) (mv 0 0))
      (rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid bound rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp r) (< r rows))) (mv 0 0))
      (e (nfix (fn2-run-installed-entries r fn2-run-installed)))
      (run (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)))
      ((unless (or force (<= e (* 2 (nfix acc))))) (mv 0 0))
      ((mv n least) (fn2-seal-select (- i 1) (+ (nfix acc) e) run force sid fn2-run-installed)))
  (mv (+ 1 (nfix n)) (if (equal (nfix n) 0) run (nfix least)))))
; Free rows of the page class (its free count; 0 when the pool has no such class).
(defun fn2-seal-free-pages (fn2-pool)

                    (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers)
                    (fn2-run-restarts-wfp fn2-run-restarts) (fn2-run-cache-wfp fn2-run-cache) (fn2-ribbon-builds-wfp fn2-ribbon-builds)

                      fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
                      fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)

before.range:
; Layer C3: range reads over a schema's overlays and live runs, and the read
; contract (UNIVERSAL-CONSTRUCTIONS 2.4 with section 12 decision 2).
;
; A range read delivers, in key order, the entries whose keys lie in
; [lo, hi]: a merge of one source per overlay of the schema (active or
; frozen) and per live run. Each source holds one decoded head; a step
; advances the sources that need it, delivers the least head, and makes
; that key's successor the query, so the read's meaning is its resume key
; and the schema's version, never a physical position. When the version
; moved (a seal, a merge) every source is found again strictly after the
; resume key; when an overlay took an insert its source is located again.
; Equal keys in two sources (an overlay and the run it is being sealed into)
; deliver once, the newest source winning: an overlay is newer than any
; run, a run with a greater identifier newer than one with a smaller, an
; overlay taken later (its SEQ: batch order, C-S3) newer than one taken
; earlier.
; Range reads take schemas whose key fields are integers (C-RANGE-KEYS).
; Every step is bounded; :more resumes, :miss names the page a run source's
; cursor waits for.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "runs-assemble")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

(defcolumns fn2-ranges
 ((phase (:enum fn2-range-phase (:idle :seek :merge :done)))
  (schema :u60) (qbase :u32) (hbase :u32) (sbase :u32) (smax :u32) (scount :u32)
  (cbase :u32) (rbase :u32) (vrun :u60) (pfield :u32) (plimit :u60)
  (out :u32) (ok :u8) (os :u32) (og :u60) (delivered :u60)
  (qk :u8) (qs :u32) (qg :u60)))
; A source's SRC is its overlay row or its run's fn2-run-installed row (not
; named REF: the reference view names each core child's copy NAME-REF).
(defcolumns fn2-range-sources
 ((kind (:enum fn2-range-kind (:none :overlay :run)))
  (src :u32) (state (:enum fn2-range-state (:seek :next :scan :head :end)))
  (pos :u32) (count :u32) (cursor :u32) (rb :u32) (run :u60)
  (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)))
; A read with no position limit names this field.
(defconst *fn2-range-no-position* 4294967295)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The read contract. STRENGTH is :exactly-at or :at-least, P the position
; asked for, FALLBACK :wait, :stale-ok or :catch-up, COV the schema's
; coverage, APPEND whether the schema is a stream (an entry never changes,
; so its prefix at any position up to cov is retained) or latest-only.
; (mv outcome position limit): :read at POSITION, LIMIT the greatest
; position a delivered stream entry may carry (nil: none); :stale (read at
; cov, said so); :wait (at cov; come back when cov reaches p); :gap (exact
; history at p is not retained); :unavailable (catch-up needs maintenance
; state and a suffix interpreter this schema does not have); :refused.
; Every outcome carries its position.
(defun fn2-read-plan (strength p fallback cov append)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (cond ((not (and (natp p) (natp cov) (member-eq strength '(:exactly-at :at-least))
                  (member-eq fallback '(:wait :stale-ok :catch-up))))
        (mv :refused 0 nil))
       ((<= p cov)
        (cond ((eq strength :at-least) (mv :read cov nil))
              (append (mv :read p p))
              ((equal p cov) (mv :read cov nil))
              (t (mv :gap cov nil))))
       ((eq fallback :wait) (mv :wait cov nil))
       ((eq fallback :stale-ok) (mv :stale cov nil))
       (t (mv :unavailable cov nil))))
(assert-event (and (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 5 :wait 9 t)) '(:read 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 5 :wait 9 t)) '(:read 5 5))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 5 :wait 9 nil)) '(:gap 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 9 :wait 9 nil)) '(:read 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 12 :wait 9 t)) '(:wait 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 12 :stale-ok 9 t)) '(:stale 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 12 :catch-up 9 t)) '(:unavailable 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :sometime 1 :wait 9 t)) '(:refused 0 nil))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Sources. Source I of range G is row SBASE+I; a run source reads through
; cursor row CBASE+I; every source's head is decoded at the reader region
; RBASE + I * reader-fields (its entry rows at +*fn2-run-reader-entry*).
(defmacro fn2-rg-ok (g) `(and (natp ,g) (< ,g (fn2-ranges-rows fn2-ranges))))
(defun fn2-range-add-source (g i kind ref run ok os og fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources)
  :guard (and (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-rg-ok g) (natp i))) (mv :bounds fn2-range-sources))
      ((unless (< i (fn2-ranges-smax g fn2-ranges))) (mv :sources fn2-range-sources))
      (row (+ (fn2-ranges-sbase g fn2-ranges) i))
      (cursor (+ (fn2-ranges-cbase g fn2-ranges) i))
      (rb (+ (fn2-ranges-rbase g fn2-ranges) (* i *fn2-run-reader-fields*)))
      ((unless (and (< row (fn2-range-sources-rows fn2-range-sources)) (natp kind) (< kind *fn2-range-kind-count*)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 ref) (unsigned-byte-p 32 cursor) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rb) (unsigned-byte-p 60 run)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 ok) (unsigned-byte-p 32 os) (unsigned-byte-p 60 og)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-range-sources))
      (fn2-range-sources (fn2-range-sources-put row (kind kind) (src ref) (state *fn2-range-state-seek*) (pos 0) (count 0)
                                                (cursor cursor) (rb rb) (run run) (okind ok) (oslot os) (ogen og))))
  (mv :ok fn2-range-sources)))
(fn2-range-sources-preserves fn2-range-add-source (g i kind ref run ok os og fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources) :position 1 :raw-rows t
 :hyps ((fn2-rangesp fn2-ranges) (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sourcesp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources)))
; The schema's overlays (active or frozen), from overlay row N-1 down; I is
; the next source index. (mv code i sources)
(defun fn2-range-add-overlays (n i g sid fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays) :measure (nfix n)
  :guard (and (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)
              (natp n) (<= n (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)) (natp i))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-range-add-source)))))
 (b* (((when (zp n)) (mv :ok i fn2-range-sources))
      (o (- n 1))
      ((unless (and (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
                    (member (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) (list *fn2-overlay-phase-active* *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*))))
       (fn2-range-add-overlays (- n 1) i g sid fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays))

       (fn2-range-add-source g i *fn2-range-kind-overlay* o (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-okind o fn2-overlays)
                             (fn2-overlays-oslot o fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-ogen o fn2-overlays) fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))

(fn2-range-sources-preserves fn2-range-add-overlays (n i g sid fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays) :position 2 :raw-rows t
 :hyps ((fn2-rangesp fn2-ranges) (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sourcesp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources)))

(defun fn2-range-add-runs (n i g sid rlo fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-installed)

                             (fn2-run-installed-okind r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-oslot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-ogen r fn2-run-installed) fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code i fn2-range-sources)))

; strictly after the current query, the version taken now.
(defun fn2-range-enumerate (g fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-run-installed)

  :guard (and (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)
              (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-range-add-overlays fn2-range-add-runs)))))

      (sid (fn2-ranges-schema g fn2-ranges))

     (fn2-rgs-run sid layout sources prefix p hi pidx budget fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   ;; Keystone (INBOX 4.1, Seek(stream, after = p)).
   (defthm-owed fn2-range-seek-position (sources prefix p hi budget)
    (implies (and (fn2-range-inputp *fn2-overview-entry* '((group (:id group)) (number (:id group-number))) sources budget)
                  (true-listp prefix) (equal (len prefix) 1) (natp p) (posp hi) (unsigned-byte-p 59 hi)
                  (fn2-range-monotonep '((group (:id group)) (number (:id group-number))) sources prefix 3))
             (equal (car (fn2-range-seek-image 3 *fn2-overview-entry* sources prefix p hi 3 budget))
                    (fn2-range-seek-spec '((group (:id group)) (number (:id group-number))) sources prefix p hi 3)))
    :teeth (fn2-range-seek-position-positive fn2-range-seek-position-negative)
    :schema :g1 :claim :representation
    :doc "Within one stream (a group's overview, positions growing with numbers), the positioned seek over the overlay and runs answers the number from which a read delivers exactly the entries after commit position p: one past the last entry at or before p.")
   ))
before.sealer-unit:
; Layer C1c unit: the sealer's engine half (books/sealer.lisp) on real runs.
; Overlays of one schema are loaded through the real insert, published
; (frozen, SEQ in batch order) and sealed by driving the real fn2-seal-step
; until it is idle; then every query is looked up through the real run
; cursor in the installed runs, newest run first. The keystones
; fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay and fn2-manifest-replacement-atomic, their
; adapters and teeth.
; Run: sh tools/certify.sh tests/sealer-unit.lisp
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "runs-assembly")
(include-book "../books/sealer")

(defconst *fn2-su-stobjs*
 '(fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache
   fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))
;; A b* binding (fn2-su-bind (v ...) call) binds V ... and every stobj.
(defun fn2-su-expand (x)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom x) x)
       ((and (eq (car x) 'fn2-su-bind) (consp (cdr x)) (consp (cddr x)))
        (list (cons 'mv (append (cadr x) *fn2-su-stobjs*)) (fn2-su-expand (caddr x))))
       (t (cons (fn2-su-expand (car x)) (fn2-su-expand (cdr x))))))
(defmacro fn2-su-defun (name args &rest r)
 (let* ((measure (and (eq (car r) :measure) (cadr r))) (body (if measure (caddr r) (car r))))
  `(defun ,name ,(append args *fn2-su-stobjs*)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs ,*fn2-su-stobjs* :verify-guards nil ,@(and measure `(:measure ,measure))))
    ,(fn2-su-expand body))))
(defmacro fn2-su-mv (&rest values) `(mv ,@values ,@*fn2-su-stobjs*))
(defmacro fn2-su-call (name &rest args) `(,name ,@args ,@*fn2-su-stobjs*))

; Field plan: the sealer's rows from 1500 (its merge's query at 2780 and
; sources' readers from 2860, C5); an entry being loaded at 3700, the
; overlay's decode scratch at 3800; the run adapter's reader at 1200 and
; query at 1310. Writer rows 0-6 the sealer's; checker row 0, digest rows
; 0-135. Owner (9 0 1); the query's (10 0 1).
(defconst *fn2-su-fbase* 1500)
(defconst *fn2-su-e* 3700)
(defconst *fn2-su-eb* 3800)
(defconst *fn2-su-icap* 64)
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-setup (rows pfill)
 (b* ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-init 1 fn2-seals))
      (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init rows fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-overlay-index-init (* rows *fn2-su-icap*) fn2-overlay-index))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init 16 fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-init 1 fn2-run-builds))
      (fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-init *fn2-seal-writer-rows* fn2-run-writers))
      (fn2-run-restarts (fn2-run-restarts-init (* *fn2-seal-writer-rows* *fn2-run-restart-capacity*) fn2-run-restarts))
      (fn2-run-cache (fn2-run-cache-init 1024 fn2-run-cache))
      (fn2-ribbon-builds (fn2-ribbon-builds-init 1 fn2-ribbon-builds))
      (fn2-ribbon-band (fn2-ribbon-band-init (fn2-ribbon-slots *fn2-su-icap*) fn2-ribbon-band))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-init 3900 fn2-fields))
      (fn2-pool (fn2-pool-init '((300 . 65536)) 1 100 fn2-pool))
      (fn2-fc (fn2-fc-init 1 fn2-fc))
      (fn2-fc-context (fn2-fc-context-init 1 fn2-fc-context))
      (fn2-b3 (fn2-b3-table-init 1 fn2-b3))
      (fn2-digests (fn2-digests-init 150 fn2-digests))
      (fn2-run-cursors (fn2-run-cursors-init 9 fn2-run-cursors))
      (fn2-run-paths (fn2-run-paths-init (* 9 *fn2-run-max-levels*) fn2-run-paths))
      (fn2-ranges (fn2-ranges-init 1 fn2-ranges))
      (fn2-range-sources (fn2-range-sources-init 8 fn2-range-sources))
      ((mv code fn2-seals) (fn2-seal-init 0 *fn2-su-fbase* 0 pfill 9 0 1 1 1 fn2-seals))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv code))
      ;; the merge (C5): range row 0, sources 0-7 through cursors 1-8
      ((mv code fn2-seals) (fn2-seal-merge-rows 0 0 1 (+ *fn2-su-fbase* *fn2-seal-field-rows*)
                                                (+ *fn2-su-fbase* *fn2-seal-field-rows* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) fn2-seals)))
  (fn2-su-mv code)))
; Load overlay O of SID with ENTRIES (inserted in order), SEQ, then publish
; it (frozen) unless PRIVATE.
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-load-entries (layout entries o src sgen off)
 (if (atom entries) (fn2-su-mv :ok)
  (b* (((mv code off fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-load-values layout (car entries) *fn2-su-e* src sgen off 9 0 1 fn2-fields fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
       ((mv code fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
        (fn2-ov-insert o *fn2-su-e* *fn2-su-eb* fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :insert code))))
   (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load-entries layout (cdr entries) o src sgen off))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-load (sid layout batches o seqs private)
 (if (atom batches) (fn2-su-mv :ok)
  (b* (((mv & aslot agen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 9 0 1 fn2-pool))
       ((mv & src sgen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 9 0 1 fn2-pool))
       ((mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool)
        (fn2-ov-start o sid aslot agen (* o *fn2-su-icap*) *fn2-su-icap* 9 0 1 0 fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :start code)))
       (fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load-entries layout (car batches) o src sgen 0))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv code))
       ((mv & fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release src sgen 9 0 1 fn2-pool))
       (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-set-seq o (car seqs) fn2-overlays))
       ((mv code fn2-overlays)
        (if (and (atom (cdr batches)) private)
            (fn2-ov-advance o *fn2-overlay-phase-active* *fn2-overlay-phase-private* fn2-overlays)
          (fn2-ov-freeze o fn2-overlays)))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :freeze code))))
   (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load sid layout (cdr batches) (+ 1 o) (cdr seqs) private))))
; Drive the sealer until it is idle or has installed LIMIT runs; (code
; done-count).
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-drive (fuel limit done) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (if (or (zp fuel) (and (natp limit) (<= limit done))) (fn2-su-mv (if (zp fuel) :fuel :limit) done)
  (b* (((mv code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
            fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
            fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
        (fn2-seal-step 4096 fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                       fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                       fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)))
   (case code
    (:idle (fn2-su-mv :idle done))
    ((:more :retired) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive (- fuel 1) limit done))
    (:done (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive (- fuel 1) limit (+ 1 done)))
    (otherwise (fn2-su-mv code done))))))
; Look Q up in SID's live runs, newest first, below BOUND: (:found entry)
; from the first run holding its key, else (:absent).
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-lookup (fuel sid layout bound) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (b* ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid bound rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((when (or (zp fuel) (not (< r rows)))) (fn2-su-mv (list :absent)))
      ((mv & fn2-run-cursors)
       (fn2-run-cursor-start 0 sid (fn2-run-installed-top r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-slot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-gen r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-counter r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-run-reader* 9 0 1 fn2-run-cursors))
      ((mv code fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields) (fn2-run-run-steps 100000 fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
  (if (eq code :found)
      (fn2-su-mv (list :found (fn2-run-unload-values layout (+ *fn2-run-run-reader* *fn2-run-reader-entry*) fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
    (if (eq code :absent)
        (fn2-su-call fn2-su-lookup (- fuel 1) sid layout (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-su-mv (list code))))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-queries (sid layout queries)
 (if (atom queries) (fn2-su-mv nil)
  (b* (((mv & qslot qgen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 10 0 1 fn2-pool))
       ((mv & & fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-load-values layout (car queries) *fn2-run-run-query* qslot qgen 0 10 0 1 fn2-fields fn2-pool))
       (fn2-su-bind (answer) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-lookup 20 sid layout *fn2-u60-max*))
       ((mv & fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release qslot qgen 10 0 1 fn2-pool))
       (fn2-su-bind (rest) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-queries sid layout (cdr queries))))
   (fn2-su-mv (cons answer rest)))))
; The live runs' (schema run entries filter) and the overlay phases.
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-installed (r k) :measure (nfix k)
 (if (or (zp k) (not (natp r)) (<= (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) r)) (fn2-su-mv nil)
  (b* ((live (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*))
       (row (list (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)
                  (fn2-run-installed-entries r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-filter r fn2-run-installed)))
       (fn2-su-bind (rest) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed (+ 1 r) (- k 1))))
   (fn2-su-mv (if live (cons row rest) rest)))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-phases (o k) :measure (nfix k)
 (if (or (zp k) (not (natp o)) (<= (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) o)) (fn2-su-mv nil)
  (b* ((p (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays)) (fn2-su-bind (rest) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-phases (+ 1 o) (- k 1))))
   (fn2-su-mv (cons p rest)))))
; The image: setup, load, seal (at most LIMIT runs), then (drive-code done
; answers installed phases).
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-run (sid layout batches seqs private limit pfill queries)
 (b* ((fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-setup (+ 1 (len batches)) pfill))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :setup code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load sid layout batches 0 seqs private))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (code done) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive 1000000 limit 0))
      (fn2-su-bind (answers) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-queries sid layout queries))
      (fn2-su-bind (installed) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed 0 16))
      (fn2-su-bind (phases) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-phases 0 (+ 1 (len batches)))))
  (fn2-su-mv (list code done answers installed phases))))
(defun fn2-sealer-image (sid layout batches seqs private limit pfill queries)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-run-with-local (fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache
                      fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources)
  (mv-let (r fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache
             fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources)
    (fn2-su-run sid layout batches seqs private limit pfill queries fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources)
   (mv r fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache
       fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Specification: the newest batch (the last in SEQ order) holding Q's key.
(defun fn2-su-find (key entries q)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom entries) nil)
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car entries) q) :eq) (list (car entries)))
       (t (fn2-su-find key (cdr entries) q))))
(defun fn2-sealer-lookup-spec (key batches q)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom batches) (list :absent)
  (let ((later (fn2-sealer-lookup-spec key (cdr batches) q)) (here (fn2-su-find key (car batches) q)))
   (if (eq (car later) :found) later (if here (list :found (car here)) later)))))
(defun fn2-sealer-spec (key batches queries)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom queries) nil (cons (fn2-sealer-lookup-spec key batches (car queries)) (fn2-sealer-spec key batches (cdr queries)))))
(defun fn2-su-seqs (n i) (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix n))) (if (zp n) nil (cons i (fn2-su-seqs (- n 1) (+ 1 i)))))
; The identity summary (C §4a, schema 13): the schema whose runs carry a filter.
(defconst *fn2-su-summary* '((namespace (:id namespace)) (name (:octets 250)) (selected (:id candidate)) (resolution (:id event))
                             (candidates :u60) (evidence :u60) (history :u60) (gaps :u60)))
(defconst *fn2-su-summary-key* '((namespace (:id namespace)) (name (:octets 250))))
; Inputs: at most four batches, each at most 48 distinct well-formed keys.
(defun fn2-sealer-inputp (layout key batches)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom batches)
     (and (consp (car batches)) (fn2-ov-inputp layout key (car batches)) (<= (len (car batches)) 48)
          (fn2-sealer-inputp layout key (cdr batches)))))

(defconst *fn2-su-groups* '((name (:octets 250)) (group (:id group))))
(defconst *fn2-su-groups-key* '((name (:octets 250))))
(defun fn2-su-name (j) (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil)) (list 97 46 (+ 97 (floor j 26)) (+ 97 (mod j 26))))
(defun fn2-su-batch (from n v)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix n)))
 (if (zp n) nil (cons (list (fn2-su-name from) (+ v from)) (fn2-su-batch (+ 1 from) (- n 1) v))))
; Three batches over names 0-29: names 0-19 (group = 100 + j), 10-29 (200 +
; j), 5-14 (300 + j); the newest row of each name is the answer.
(defconst *fn2-su-batches* (list (fn2-su-batch 0 20 100) (fn2-su-batch 10 20 200) (fn2-su-batch 5 10 300)))
(defconst *fn2-su-queries*
 (list (list (fn2-su-name 0) 0) (list (fn2-su-name 7) 0) (list (fn2-su-name 12) 0) (list (fn2-su-name 17) 0)
       (list (fn2-su-name 25) 0) (list (fn2-su-name 29) 0) (list (fn2-su-name 30) 0) (list nil 0)))

(defthm-owed fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay (batches queries pfill)
 (implies (and (fn2-sealer-inputp *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-groups-key* batches) (<= (len batches) 4)
               (natp pfill) (<= 400 pfill) (<= pfill *fn2-run-page-size*))
          (equal (caddr (fn2-sealer-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* batches (fn2-su-seqs (len batches) 1) nil nil pfill queries))
                 (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* batches queries)))
 :teeth (fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay-positive fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay-negative)
 :schema :invariant
 :doc "The sealer seals published overlays into runs in SEQ order through the real build; every lookup through the runs, newest first, answers as the overlays did (the newest batch holding the key), at any page pfill that holds two entries.")
(defun fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay-positive ()
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((spec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-batches* *fn2-su-queries*)))
  (and (fn2-sealer-inputp *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-batches*)
       (equal (caddr (fn2-sealer-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-batches* '(1 2 3) nil nil 400 *fn2-su-queries*)) spec)
       (equal (caddr (fn2-sealer-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-batches* '(1 2 3) nil nil *fn2-run-page-size* *fn2-su-queries*)) spec)
       ; non-vacuous: answers from each batch and an absent one
       (equal (strip-cars spec) '(:found :found :found :found :found :found :absent :absent)))))
; Teeth: (1) a sealer that stops before the last overlay answers name 7 from
; batch 1 where batch 3 is newest; (2) run order must follow SEQ: batches
; published with SEQs against their order read back the older rows.
(defun fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay-negative ()
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((spec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-batches* *fn2-su-queries*)))
  (and (not (equal (caddr (fn2-sealer-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-batches* '(1 2 3) nil 2 400 *fn2-su-queries*)) spec))
       (not (equal (caddr (fn2-sealer-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-batches* '(3 2 1) nil nil 400 *fn2-su-queries*)) spec)))))
(fn2-assert-owed-teeth fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay)

;; The engine half of the run replacement: at every cut of the sealer's
;; steps, the resident view holds the runs before the seal or the runs after
;; it, never a third set; the overlay is published until the cut that
;; installs its run and free from that cut on, so a reader sees each fact in
;; exactly one place. (The device half adds B5's recovery over the
;; run-replacement member: the recovered manifest is the old or the new.)
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-cuts (fuel prev acc) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (if (zp fuel) (fn2-su-mv (reverse acc))
  (b* (((mv code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
            fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
            fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
        (fn2-seal-step 4096 fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                       fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                       fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths))
       (fn2-su-bind (installed) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed 0 16))
       (fn2-su-bind (phases) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-phases 0 1))
       (view (list installed phases))
       (acc (if (equal view prev) acc (cons view acc))))
   (if (member-eq code '(:more :retired :done)) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-cuts (- fuel 1) view acc) (fn2-su-mv (reverse acc))))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-cut-run (sid layout batch pfill)
 (b* ((fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-setup 2 pfill))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :setup code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load sid layout (list batch) 0 '(1) nil))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (installed) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed 0 16))
      (fn2-su-bind (phases) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-phases 0 1))
      (fn2-su-bind (views) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-cuts 100000 (list installed phases) (list (list installed phases)))))
  (fn2-su-mv views)))

(defthm-owed fn2-manifest-replacement-atomic (sid batch pfill)
 (implies (and (member sid '(13 8)) (consp batch) (<= (len batch) 48) (natp pfill) (<= 400 pfill) (<= pfill *fn2-run-page-size*)

 :teeth (fn2-manifest-replacement-atomic-positive fn2-manifest-replacement-atomic-negative)
 :schema :invariant
 :doc "Engine half of the run replacement: at every cut of one seal the resident view holds the old runs with the overlay published or the new run with the overlay retired, never both or neither; the device half (B5 recovery over the run-replacement member) owes the same of the recovered manifest.")

      (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-set-phase 1 *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* fn2-overlays))

(defconst *fn2-su-c5-batches*
 (list (fn2-su-batch 0 12 100) (fn2-su-batch 6 12 200) (fn2-su-batch 12 12 300) (fn2-su-batch 18 12 400)
       (fn2-su-batch 0 10 500) (fn2-su-batch 8 10 600) (fn2-su-batch 14 10 700) (fn2-su-batch 4 16 800)))

(defthm-owed fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims (batches queries pfill)
 (implies (and (fn2-sealer-inputp *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-groups-key* batches)
               (consp batches) (<= (len batches) 8)
               (natp pfill) (<= 400 pfill) (<= pfill *fn2-run-page-size*))
          (let ((img (fn2-sealer-cap-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* batches 4 24 pfill queries)))
           (and (equal (car img) :idle)
                (<= (len batches) (cadr img))
                (equal (caddr img) (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* batches queries))
                (<= (len (cadddr img)) 4)
                (< 16 (nth 4 img)))))
 :teeth (fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-positive fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-negative)
 :schema :invariant
 :doc "Minimal C5: sealing up to 8 batches across a 4-row installed-run table and 24-page pool merges superseded runs, reclaims their installed-run rows and 64 KiB page slots in :release, and preserves newest-wins lookup semantics.")

(defun fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-positive ()
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let* ((spec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-c5-batches* *fn2-su-queries*))
        (img (fn2-sealer-cap-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-c5-batches* 4 24 400 *fn2-su-queries*))
        (sbatches (list (fn2-su-facts 0 6) (fn2-su-facts 3 6) (fn2-su-facts 6 6) (fn2-su-facts 9 6)))
        (squeries (list (fn2-su-fact 0 7) (fn2-su-fact 5 7) (fn2-su-fact 14 7) (fn2-su-fact 99 7)))
        (sspec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-summary-key* sbatches squeries))
        (simg (fn2-sealer-cap-image 13 *fn2-su-summary* sbatches 3 20 400 squeries)))
  (and (fn2-sealer-inputp *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-c5-batches*)
       (equal (car img) :idle)
       (<= 8 (cadr img))
       (equal (caddr img) spec)
       (equal (cadddr img) '((8 8 30 0)))
       (equal (nth 4 img) 23)
       ;; Identity summary (schema 13) multi-run merge skips single-overlay Ribbon filter (filter = 0)
       (equal (car simg) :idle)
       (equal (caddr simg) sspec)
       (equal (cadddr simg) '((13 4 15 0)))
       (equal (nth 4 simg) 19)
       (equal (fn2-su-c5-mechanisms-result) '(:idle 2 nil t :idle 2 t 1 t t t :full 2 t)))))

(defun fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-negative ()
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((spec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-c5-batches* *fn2-su-queries*))
       ;; Only 1 installed-run row cannot hold a live run plus a replacement row before retiring: :full
       (too-small (fn2-sealer-cap-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-c5-batches* 1 24 400 *fn2-su-queries*))
       ;; Reversed batch order yields older values on overlapping keys, refuting oldest-wins merge
       (wrong-order (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* (reverse *fn2-su-c5-batches*) *fn2-su-queries*)))
  (and (eq (car too-small) :full)
       (not (equal wrong-order spec)))))

(fn2-assert-owed-teeth fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims)

helpers:
; Geometry is established by the actual initializer, never inferred from rows.
(defun fn2-run-installed-bank-geometry-p (fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-bank-configured fn2-run-installed) 1)
      (posp (fn2-run-installed-bank-capacity fn2-run-installed))
      (equal (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)
       (+ (fn2-run-installed-resident-limit fn2-run-installed)
          (* 2 (fn2-run-installed-bank-capacity fn2-run-installed))))))
(defun fn2-run-installed-bank-start (bank fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp bank) (< bank 2))))
 (+ (fn2-run-installed-resident-limit fn2-run-installed)
    (* bank (fn2-run-installed-bank-capacity fn2-run-installed))))
(defun fn2-run-installed-bank-row-p (bank r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (and (fn2-run-installed-bank-geometry-p fn2-run-installed)
      (natp bank) (< bank 2) (natp r)
      (<= (fn2-run-installed-bank-start bank fn2-run-installed) r)
      (< r (+ (fn2-run-installed-bank-start bank fn2-run-installed)
              (fn2-run-installed-bank-capacity fn2-run-installed)))))
(defun fn2-run-installed-init-configured (resident capacity fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed
  :guard (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 resident) (posp capacity)
              (unsigned-byte-p 32 capacity) (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ resident (* 2 capacity))))))
 (let* ((fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init (+ resident (* 2 capacity)) fn2-run-installed))
        (fn2-run-installed (update-fn2-run-installed-resident-limit resident fn2-run-installed))
        (fn2-run-installed (update-fn2-run-installed-bank-capacity capacity fn2-run-installed))
        (fn2-run-installed (update-fn2-run-installed-bank-configured 1 fn2-run-installed)))
  fn2-run-installed))
