; Cold C source adoption: one directory row per step while boot is non-serving.
; The authority opener lives above cold selected-candidate/root4 evidence.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "std/util/bstar" :dir :system)
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-leases")
(include-book "machines-c-successor")
(include-book "sealer")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

(defun fn2-checkpoint-summary-apply-step (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals)
 :guard (and (fn2-checkpoint-summary-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-wfp fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
             (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-id-engine-wfp fn2-id-engine) (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals))))
 (b* (((unless (and (< 0 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary))
                    (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-applying*)
                    (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-application-stage 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) 2)
                    (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-lease-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) 0)
                    (< 0 (fn2-id-engine-rows fn2-id-engine))
                    (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals))
                    (<= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))))
       (mv :source fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals))
      (e (fn2-checkpoint-summary-cursor 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
      (tag (fn2-checkpoint-summary-tag 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
      ((when (>= e (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rows fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)))
       (if (not (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-installed 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
           (mv :coverage fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals)
        (let* ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-put 0
                (seq (+ (fn2-checkpoint-summary-priority-base 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
                (published (fn2-checkpoint-summary-cut-event 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))))
               (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-runs 0 (+ (fn2-checkpoint-summary-priority-base 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) (fn2-checkpoint-summary-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary)) fn2-seals))
               (fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-set-phase 0 *fn2-checkpoint-summary-phase-applied* fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
         (mv :applied fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals))))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 1 e))) (mv :bounds fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals))
      ((unless (= (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-tag e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) tag))
       (let ((fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-set-cursor 0 (+ 1 e) fn2-checkpoint-summary)))
        (mv :more fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals)))
      (rank (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-rank e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources))
      (r (nfix (- rank 1)))
      ((unless (and (posp rank) (<= rank (fn2-checkpoint-summary-count 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))
                    (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
                    (= (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-free*)
                    (< (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-top e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) *fn2-run-max-levels*)))
       (mv :directory fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals))
      ((mv install-code fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-install-physical r (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-schema e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (+ (fn2-checkpoint-summary-priority-base 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary) rank) rank
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-top e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-entries e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-unit e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-epoch e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-allocation e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       tag
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-0 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-1 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-2 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-3 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-4 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-5 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-6 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources)
       (fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources-hash-7 e fn2-checkpoint-summary-sources) fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (eq install-code :ok)) (mv install-code fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals))
      (fn2-checkpoint-summary (fn2-checkpoint-summary-put 0 (cursor (+ 1 e))
       (installed (+ 1 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-installed 0 fn2-checkpoint-summary))))))
  (mv :more fn2-checkpoint-summary fn2-run-installed fn2-id-engine fn2-seals)))
